name: minemarket
description: MineMarket - Plataforma Transaccional de Items Digitales para Servidores de Minecraft

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/tests frontend/src frontend/tests frontend/e2e
